candidates.text: Venue: Oak Street community hall (bookings desk, open weekdays). Payments are by cash or bank transfer; the deposit is r
Rooms to consider (approx. cost per evening, from the hall's price list): small room ~15, main hall ~40, garden room ~25
Suggested: the small room for the first swap; ask about the garden room for summer.
Check the hall calendar for free first Saturdays before calling.
Before paying: ask about the cleaning fee, not just the room price.
After booking: add the date to the group's shared calendar and keep the receipt.
Check whether the hall lends folding tables and shelves.
Write the flyer
Set up the sign-up form
Noticeboards → library, corner shop, school gate → ask before pinning.
Post the flyer in the neighbourhood group and pin the <FORM-LINK> post.
Hand out flyers
Send a reminder to everyone who signed up. You get a count of helpers to plan with.
Every new sign-up gets a thank-you reply.
On the morning → Unlock → Set up tables → put up a sign for each type of book (fiction, non-fiction, children's).
Because the hall has to be empty by 14:00, plan the pack-down
Back at home, count the books swapped and the people who came. Share the numbers in the group.
Optional: ask people to leave a note on a card (what they liked, what to change) so the next swap is better.
Book the same room for the next three months and share the dates; the group calendar updates itself.
